question.prompt: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(AB=AC\), \(\angle B=60^\circ\), and \(BC=5\). Find the perimeter of \(\triangle ABC\).

solutions.explanation: \(\angle C=\angle B=60^\circ\), and \(\angle A=60^\circ\). The triangle is equilateral, so its perimeter is \(3\times5=15\).
solutions.title: Establish that the triangle is equilateral
